mintAuthority.summary: At Ethereum block 26095794 on 2026-10-01, BRZ owner 0xaf24 is a 2-of-3 Safe and masterMinter 0x2c64 is a separate 2-of-4 Safe. Neither is itself a currently configured minter: owner can replace masterMinter, and masterMinter can authorize minters with arbitrary replenishable allowances. Proxy admin 0x478e is owned by the 0xaf24 owner Safe. Reviewed non-Ethereum controls include a current BSC owner contract 0xd66f and a current 1-of-2 Solana Token-2022 mint-authority multisig DzZjd6. Centralized issuance remains unbounded; no favorable authority-posture change is made.

controls.label: BRZ Ethereum owner — 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe
controls.evidence: Current observation 2026-10-01 at Ethereum block 26095794: BRZ owner() = 0xaf24edebf7fdaed86d839be018647ba6279b9d7a, whose getOwners() returns the same three recorded owners, getThreshold() = 2 and getModulesPaginated(0x1,50) returns no modules. BRZ masterMinter() = 0x2c64238ad6dca38ad373ed24b5deebfbcae90f6d, now a 2-of-4 Safe. isMinter(owner) = false and isMinter(masterMinter) = false. Verified implementation TokenV2_1 allows onlyOwner to updateMasterMinter and onlyMasterMinter to addMinter with arbitrary allowedAmount; therefore this owner control authorizes rather than directly mints. The corrected EIP-1967 admin slot returns 0x478e84519f99811be4f9e3960f7489781501542d and its owner() returns the same 0xaf24 Safe. Historical block 25294823 additionally recorded the singleton and nonce; those historical details were not date-bumped.

controls.label: BRZ Ethereum masterMinter — current 2-of-4 Safe
controls.evidence: Ethereum block 26095794: BRZ masterMinter() returns 0x2c64238ad6dca38ad373ed24b5deebfbcae90f6d; getOwners() returns the recorded four owners, getThreshold() = 2, getModulesPaginated(0x1,50) returns no modules and guard storage is zero. isMinter(masterMinter) = false. Verified implementation addMinter(address,uint256) is onlyMasterMinter and imposes no upper bound on allowedAmount; mint debits an authorized minter's allowance, but that allowance is replenishable by this control.

review.evidence: Ethereum at block 25294823: owner() = 0xaf24 (2-of-3 GnosisSafe proxy, masterCopy=0xd9db GnosisSafe 1.3.0 singleton). Safe storage: ownerCount=3, threshold=2, nonce=5. Three EOA owners confirmed via linked-list traversal. Modules sentinel = 0x1 (no modules). masterMinter 0x2c64 is an identical 2-of-3 Safe (nonce=15). ProxyAdmin 0x478e owned by same Safe. The legacy BSC owner observation was EOA 0x01455c for superseded 0x71be; current owner() on BRZ 0x0295afd3D7E86068050d64509e515f2Db71b4914 returned 0xd66f8ebda47ec5ec549ecc00fd4bbe102aa4989a, and eth_getCode on that address returned non-empty bytecode, so the current owner is a contract authority. The legacy Solana mint authority ACvei6 was a system-program wallet for superseded FtgGSFADXBtroxq8VCausXRr2of47QBf5AS1NtZCu4GD; current BRZbFNQDcWLfcdHmAkqEVnLHCAWKTRf6eHyEaWdZp3JN is a Token-2022 mint with mintAuthority DzZjd63zf674JCbQcGD7mZ8AXxrAfFE2of5coe2ZV5K1, whose authority account is an initialized 1-of-2 Token-2022 multisig by Solana RPC reads. Polygon and Base owners are also 2-of-3 Safes (threshold=2, ownerCount=3). The issuer-linked whitepaper names Transfero Asset Management LTD, incorporated in the Bahamas, as the BRZ Mint; Transfero Swiss AG (Zug) is a separate group entity whose VQF membership does not establish the BRZ Mint's prudential supervision; the only dated third-party reserve review located is a ~2020 law-firm report, and current transparency relies on Parsiq blockchain analytics rather than a recurring named accounting-firm attestation, so reconciliation is unknown. Transfero Swiss AG's Swiss oversight is VQF membership, a FINMA-recognised AML self-regulatory organisation that is explicitly not prudential supervision, and no FINMA banking/EMI licence for the BRZ issuer was found, so supervision is none. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer Safes and EOAs directly control minting across chains without an economic cap; current disclosures do not reconcile whole supply and VQF AML membership is not prudential supervision. Reconciliation finding 2026-08-15: Transfero's 2024-03-31 issuer transparency PDF gives a dated reserve and circulation snapshot, but no recurring named third-party reconciliation of BRZ liabilities against BRL reserves was located, so reconciliation remains unknown.
